now.text: In episode 87, Radcliffe sends him out of the Framework. The real Fitz wakes up remembering every terrible thing he did.

proposed.text: In episode 86, Radcliffe sends him out of the Framework. The real Fitz wakes up remembering every terrible thing he did.

changes.evidence: Radcliffe throws the Doctor through the Framework's back door and Fitz wakes on Ivanov's platform, horrified at the deaths of Agnes and Mace, in S4E20 'Farewell, Cruel World!' (overall episode 86). Episode 87 'The Return' only revisits his guilt while he is held in isolation; both events in this record happen in episode 86.

changes.evidence: Fitz wakes up on Ivanov's oil platform base in the Baltic Sea ('a base under a drilling platform in the Baltic'), not in Siberia. Siberia (the Krasnoyarsk Krai base) is where he was abducted earlier in the season. The app has no Baltic place, so the place should be dropped.
